description: List the tradable real-world assets — stocks and ETFs (AAPL, NVDA, SPY), metals and commodities (GOLD, SILVER, BRENT), stock indices (SP500, JP225) and FX. These trade as perps on Hyperliquid builder DEXes and are NOT crypto tokens; the crypto tools will not find them. Use this to answer "which stocks/commodities can I look at?".

top.description: Max assets to return (server default 200; the full universe is ~94).
